**Job Description**
 As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Corporate sector, Data Visualization \& BI you serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You are responsible for carrying out critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
   

  

 A core part of this role is enabling non\-workforce (external) users to securely log in to internally built web reporting applications through Authentication Everywhere (AuthE), the strategic authentication \& authorization platform for non\-workforce users. You'll work in a build \+ run model, owning features end\-to\-end and partnering with infrastructure and security teams to keep services reliable in production.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Creates secure and high\-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
* Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
* Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture
* Rapidly prototype and iterate on automation and integration approaches using AI\-assisted workflows (e.g., scaffolding services, generating tests, drafting technical documentation) to shorten delivery timelines and increase throughput.
* Implement and support AuthE\-based login for non\-workforce users accessing internally built web reporting applications (human interactive authentication)
* Configure and troubleshoot AuthE\-supported authentication patterns and flows used by the application (e.g., OAuth 2\.0 / OIDC and/or SAML federation, depending on the chosen pattern)
* Support access and entitlement management workflows and user access issue resolution tied to external reporting access


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* Hands\-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with Python and Django and database querying languages
* Experience building REST APIs using Django REST Framework
* Cloud experience (AWS, Cloud Foundry, or similar)
* Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.
* Overall knowledge of the Software Development Life Cycle
* Solid understanding of agile methodologies such as CI/CD, Application Resiliency, and Security


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Familiarity with AuthE capabilities used for external login (e.g., username/password \+ OTP, federated SSO via SAML, OAuth 2\.0 authorization code flow)
* Experience automating BI platforms (Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Cognos, Qlik)
* Experience building internal enterprise tools
* Familiarity with MySQL
* Experience integrating with infrastructure automation tools (e.g., Gaia, Jenkins)
